shellCommands.command: git status --short && ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f \( -name "*.tsx" -o -name "*.jsx" -o -name "*.ts" -o -name "*.js" -o -name "*.html" \) -print | head -50

cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx src/vite-env.d.ts && cat AGENTS.md && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | head -200 && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'; ls .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references
.agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button Dialog Modal 2>&1 | head -80; grep -n -i -A3 "modal\|dialog" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -60

sed -n 1,60p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; sed -n 165,200p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button Dialog 2>&1 | head -60

npm view @gravity-ui/components version 2>&1 | tail -3; npm view @gravity-ui/components@latest peerDependencies dependencies 2>&1 | head -40; npm view @gravity-ui/components versions --json 2>/dev/null | tail -15
for v in 4.24.1 4.23.0 4.20.0; do echo "== $v"; npm view @gravity-ui/components@$v peerDependencies 2>/dev/null; done

for v in 4.23.1 4.24.0; do echo "== $v"; npm view @gravity-ui/components@$v peerDependencies 2>/dev/null | grep uikit; done; npm view @gravity-ui/components@4.23.1 dependencies 2>/dev/null; curl -s -m 15 -o /tmp/cmp-llms.txt -w "%{http_code}\n" https://gravity-ui.com/llms/components/4/llms.txt; wc -c /tmp/cmp-llms.txt

head -c 300 /tmp/cmp-llms.txt; echo; for u in https://gravity-ui.com/llms/components/4.23.1/llms.txt https://gravity-ui.com/llms/components/llms.txt; do curl -s -m 15 -o /tmp/x.txt -w "$u %{http_code} %{size_download}\n" $u; done; head -c 200 /tmp/x.txt

npm install --save-exact @gravity-ui/components@4.23.1 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn Unknown" | tail -15; grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/components/package.json; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/components/ ; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/components/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/components/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head
cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/components/README.md | head -80; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/components/build | head -50; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/components/build -iname "*confirm*" | head

cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/components/build/esm/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -20; grep -n '"main"\|"module"\|"types"\|"exports"' -A3 node_modules/@gravity-ui/components/package.json | head -20; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Dialog/Dialog.d.ts | head -60

grep -n "view\|size" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts | head -20; grep -n "ButtonProps\|interface\|view" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts | head -5; grep -rn "textButtonApply\|onClickButtonApply" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Dialog/DialogFooter/DialogFooter.d.ts | head -5
cat .gitignore; git diff --stat -- package.json; grep -n "components" package.json
